name: CRT_ASSEMBLY_VERSION
doc: The CRT Assembly version, from the crtassem.h header file.

name: CRT_ASSERT
doc: Assertion failures.

name: CRT_ERROR
doc: Errors, unrecoverable problems, and issues that require immediate attention.

name: CRT_WARN
doc: Warnings, messages, and information that doesn’t need immediate attention.

name: CRTDBG_MODE_DEBUG
doc: Writes the message to the debugger’s output window.

name: CRTDBG_MODE_FILE
doc: Writes the message to a user-supplied file handle. CrtSetReportFile() should be called to define the specific file or stream to use as the destination.

name: CRTDBG_MODE_WNDW
doc: Creates a message box to display the message along with the Abort, Retry, and Ignore buttons.

name: CRTDBG_REPORT_MODE
doc: Returns current mode for the specified type.

name: CrtSetReportFile
doc: After you use CrtSetReportMode() to specify CRTDBG_MODE_FILE, you can specify the file handle to receive the message text. type must be one of the CRT_* constants listed below. file should be the file handle your want specified. Only available in debug build of Python.

name: CrtSetReportMode
doc: Specifies the destination or destinations for a specific report type generated by _CrtDbgReport() in the MS VC++ runtime. type must be one of the CRT_* constants listed below. mode must be one of the CRTDBG_* constants listed below. Only available in debug build of Python.

name: get_osfhandle
doc: Return the file handle for the file descriptor fd. Raises OSError if fd is not recognized.

name: getch
doc: Read a keypress and return the resulting character as a byte string. Nothing is echoed to the console. This call will block if a keypress is not already available, but will not wait for Enter to be pressed. If the pressed key was a special function key, this will return '\000' or '\xe0'; the next call will return the keycode. The Control-C keypress cannot be read with this function.

name: getche
doc: Similar to getch(), but the keypress will be echoed if it represents a printable character.

name: getwch
doc: Wide char variant of getch(), returning a Unicode value.

name: getwche
doc: Wide char variant of getche(), returning a Unicode value.

name: heapmin
doc: Force the malloc() heap to clean itself up and return unused blocks to the operating system. On failure, this raises OSError.

name: kbhit
doc: Returns a nonzero value if a keypress is waiting to be read. Otherwise, return 0.

name: LIBRARIES_ASSEMBLY_NAME_PREFIX
doc: The Libraries Assembly name prefix, from the crtassem.h header file.

name: LK_LOCK
doc: Locks the specified bytes. If the bytes cannot be locked, the program immediately tries again after 1 second. If, after 10 attempts, the bytes cannot be locked, OSError is raised.

name: LK_NBLCK
doc: Locks the specified bytes. If the bytes cannot be locked, OSError is raised.

name: LK_NBRLCK
doc: Locks the specified bytes. If the bytes cannot be locked, OSError is raised.

name: LK_RLCK
doc: Locks the specified bytes. If the bytes cannot be locked, the program immediately tries again after 1 second. If, after 10 attempts, the bytes cannot be locked, OSError is raised.

name: LK_UNLCK
doc: Unlocks the specified bytes, which must have been previously locked.

name: locking
doc: Lock part of a file based on file descriptor fd from the C runtime. Raises OSError on failure. The locked region of the file extends from the current file position for nbytes bytes, and may continue beyond the end of the file. mode must be one of the LK_* constants listed below. Multiple regions in a file may be locked at the same time, but may not overlap. Adjacent regions are not merged; they must be unlocked individually.

name: open_osfhandle
doc: Create a C runtime file descriptor from the file handle handle. The flags parameter should be a bitwise OR of os.O_APPEND, os.O_RDONLY, os.O_TEXT and os.O_NOINHERIT. The returned file descriptor may be used as a parameter to os.fdopen() to create a file object.

name: OUT_TO_DEFAULT
doc: Error sink is determined by the app’s type. Only available in debug build of Python.

name: OUT_TO_MSGBOX
doc: Error sink is a message box. Only available in debug build of Python.

name: OUT_TO_STDERR
doc: Error sink is a standard error. Only available in debug build of Python.

name: putch
doc: Print the byte string char to the console without buffering.

name: putwch
doc: Wide char variant of putch(), accepting a Unicode value.

name: REPORT_ERRMODE
doc: Report the current error mode value. Only available in debug build of Python.

name: set_error_mode
doc: Changes the location where the C runtime writes an error message for an error that might end the program. mode must be one of the OUT_* constants listed below or REPORT_ERRMODE. Returns the old setting or -1 if an error occurs. Only available in debug build of Python.

name: setmode
doc: Set the line-end translation mode for the file descriptor fd. To set it to text mode, flags should be os.O_TEXT; for binary, it should be os.O_BINARY.

name: ungetch
doc: Cause the byte string char to be “pushed back” into the console buffer; it will be the next character read by getch() or getche().

name: ungetwch
doc: Wide char variant of ungetch(), accepting a Unicode value.

name: VC_ASSEMBLY_PUBLICKEYTOKEN
doc: The VC Assembly public key token, from the crtassem.h header file.
